_about: Sources for pipeline/fetch_windows.py, tried in order. verified:true means the URL was read from the provider's own page on 2026-11-13; verified:false means the URL follows the provider's naming pattern but could not be opened from the build sandbox, so the fetcher probes it at run time and reports the result.
